GitHubGetRepositoryDetails.name: GitHubGetRepositoryDetails
GitHubGetRepositoryDetails.summary: Retrieve repository details, including issues, branches.

parameters.name: repo_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the repository.

returns.name: details
returns.description: Contains name (string), owner (string), description (string), url (string), branches (array of branch names), visibility (string, one of ['public', 'private']), last_updated (string, format: 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM:SS') and statistics (including number of issues, number of stars, number of forks).

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If repo_id is not a valid repository id.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time of the history period in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time of the history period in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format.

returns.name: access_history
returns.description: An array of access history events with details including guest id, guest name, guest email, access time.

GmailSendEmail.name: GmailSendEmail
GmailSendEmail.summary: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: send_at
parameters.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.

returns.name: success
returns.description: An boolean value indicating whether the email was sent successfully.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The provided email address in 'to', 'cc', or 'bcc' is malformed, any file path in 'attachments' is invalid, or the 'send_at' is not in the correct format.
